# Jelvan Ricolcol

> Jelvan Ricolcol (full name Jelvan Baloaloa Ricolcol, brand Jelvan®) is a Strategic HR Professional, Full Stack Software Developer and Certified AI & Digital Transformation Practitioner based in the Philippines and Malaysia. He holds a dual Master's in Artificial Intelligence for Business and in Human Resource and Talent Management, has 6+ years of international experience, has supported 30,000+ employees, completed 30+ projects and maintains a 100% compliance rate across HR operations.

Jelvan bridges people strategy and technology: strategic Human Resources management, AI-driven business systems and modern digital operations. He most recently worked as an English Global Advertising Expert / Meta Pro at Concentrix Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur, July 2024 - October 2026) and works as a freelance web developer for international clients.
